description: This file defines the MakerCheckerRequest class, which is a data transfer object used for carrying request parameters related to maker-checker operations within the Apache Fineract project. It includes fields annotated with @QueryParam for HTTP request query parameters, and uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: MakerCheckerRequest
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a request payload for maker-checker-related actions. Contains various fields for filtering or specifying actions, including actionName, entityName, resourceId, makerId, date ranges, client and entity identifiers.
